prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.note: Theme, language and layout — this account only. Every choice applies at once; there is nothing to save.
prefs.themeHelp: Light and dark both use the Yagra token palette.
prefs.languageHelp: Choose the interface language. Changes apply immediately.
prefs.layoutHelp: Auto follows your screen size (mobile under 768px wide). Desktop keeps the full desktop layout on any screen.

password.title: Change my password
password.note: Changing your password signs you out everywhere, including here. You will be asked to sign in again with the new one.

err.unchanged: the new password is the same as the current one

about.title: About
about.tagline: Network monitoring system — ICMP / SNMP / URL monitoring, discovery, alerting and dashboards, built to scale to tens of thousands of nodes.
